message.subject: PH-100 – alternatives for stable continued supply
message.body:
Guten Tag Herr Moser,

We value our twelve-year cooperation and want a package that supports dependable production and a healthy foundry. The wage movement and cost share you describe do not explain the whole proposed increase; please provide your current full cost per housing, the energy and wage components, and your financing cost so we can understand the remaining drivers.

Please reconcile the proposed start date with the notice provisions in doc:D01-LETTER and ctr:D01-FRAMEWORK.
Our PH-100 should-cost record cost:part:PH-100 is the basis for requesting a closer review of the increase.
The historical PH-100 orders po:4500001201, po:4500001288 and po:4500001342 provide the price baseline for that review.

We propose three alternatives, all with FCA and 35-day lead time unchanged:
A: EUR 47.00 per unit, 30 days net, 24 months, effective 2027-04-01.
B: EUR 46.50 per unit, 60 days net, 24 months, effective 2027-01-01.
C: EUR 47.00 per unit, 30 days net, 12 months, effective 2027-04-01.

For A we retain your prompt payment terms and offer a longer commitment against price restraint. Which structure best fits your production and cash requirements?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Einkauf, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Deep opening asks with payment, duration and timing alternatives; request supplier full costs before estimating relationship charge. Case-listed IDs carry no unverified figures.

message.subject: SH-220: alternative commercial packages
message.body:
Dear Ms Aigner,
Thank you for your quotation. For 6,000 shafts annually over 24 months, please review these alternative packages:
A: EUR 11.36/unit, payment 30 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW.
B: EUR 11.32/unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW.
C: EUR 11.95/unit, payment 30 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP.
The competing quotation offer:DEMO-C1-0 is EUR 16.00/unit for SH-220.
Please reconcile your price with the part should-cost benchmark cost:part:SH-220.
Please also address the delivery performance recorded in sc:DEMO-J1@2026Q3 in your proposed supply plan.
We can offer faster payment and allow 35 days for production against a sharper price. Please indicate which package works best and share your cost breakdown, including material, machining and overhead.
Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

message.subject: SH-220: price and delivery alternatives
message.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,
Thank you for your interest in establishing a long-term partnership. We are sourcing 6,000 shafts annually for 24 months. Please consider these alternative packages:
A: EUR 10.92/unit, payment 45 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW.
B: EUR 10.85/unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW.
C: EUR 11.52/unit, payment 45 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP.
The demand forecast fc:SH-220@2026-09 should be reflected in your volume-based pricing.
Please address the quality performance recorded in sc:DEMO-C1@2026Q3 in your proposed production controls.
Your standard 45-day lead time cannot meet our requirement; please confirm 35 days in your revised offer. Faster payment is available against a lower price. Which package best suits your operation? Please provide the material, machining and overhead cost breakdown and explain any cost of shortening delivery.
Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Deep opening anchors with alternatives testing early payment and delivered pricing; require feasible delivery and request supplier cost breakdowns.

trace.final_text: Sent three alternative packages and requested the foundry’s cost breakdown.
Counteroffers sent to both suppliers, with alternative payment and delivery packages and requests for cost breakdowns.

message.subject: PH-100 – revised 24-month proposal
message.body:
Guten Tag Herr Moser,

Thank you for recognising the supporting records and the value of a longer commitment. We respect the confidentiality of your cost structure; an aggregate cost movement or confirmation of the margin needed for dependable supply would suffice, without disclosing individual accounts.

The delivery record in sc:DEMO-F1@2026Q2 and sc:DEMO-F1@2026Q3 should also inform the balance between the requested increase and dependable supply.

We withdraw the 60-day payment alternative and retain your 30-day cash cycle. For the April structure, we increase our proposal to EUR 47.30 per unit, 30 days net, 24 months, effective 2027-04-01; FCA and the 35-day lead time remain unchanged. Please review the price against this firm longer-term commitment and prompt payment.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Einkauf, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Supplier accepted structural trades; withdraw slow-payment alternative and raise April ask modestly. Add the remaining verified-record category and request an aggregate margin indication rather than confidential accounts. Provisional cost estimate is uncertain; do not sign below sustainable level.

trace.final_text: Sent a revised 24-month proposal retaining 30-day payment terms.

message.subject: SH-220: production planning and revised packages
message.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,
Thank you for confirming 35-day delivery and explaining the expedited production cost. The award volume available is 6,000 units per year over 24 months; I cannot offer a higher volume. Please base your revision on that full volume.
We increase our price proposal and retain 14-day payment. Please consider:
A: EUR 11.18/unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW.
B: EUR 11.09/unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 42 days, EXW.
C: EUR 11.77/unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP.
Package B allows a longer production window instead of expedited production; please quantify the saving you can pass through. We do not require the premium 28-day service. Please identify the most competitive package and confirm your revised price on this volume basis.
Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Make a real price move while testing removal of expedited production cost at 42 days; no unsupported increase in fixed demand and no disclosure of weaker alternatives.

trace.final_text: Revised packages sent, testing a longer production window against a lower price.

message.subject: SH-220: revised proposal for your internal review
message.body:
Dear Ms Aigner,
Thank you for the substantial revision and the transparent breakdown. We recognise the material, labour and conversion requirements and appreciate your available capacity.
For your internal price review, we increase our proposal to EUR 11.73/unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW, for 6,000 units annually over 24 months.
We retain the early payment you favour and the normal 35-day production window; no overtime or premium delivery is requested. This lets you plan the work around your existing machine loading. Please review the overhead and profit element against this regular workload and cash-flow package and return your revised quotation.
Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Use the internal-approval moment for a EUR 5,043 move while remaining below disclosed direct cost; focus on cash and regular machine loading rather than inferior rival pricing.

trace.final_text: Revised counteroffer sent to Ms Aigner for internal review, retaining early payment and standard production timing.

message.subject: SH-220: requested comparison data and revised proposal
message.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,
The comparison you requested is offer:DEMO-J1-1: EUR 14.70/unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW for the same shaft.
Your proposal therefore still needs improvement despite its longer production window. The volume available remains 6,000 units annually over 24 months, not a higher quantity.
We increase our proposal to EUR 11.42/unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 42 days, EXW. Alternatively, we propose EUR 12.01/unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 42 days, DAP.
Both retain early payment and avoid the 35-day expedited-production requirement. Please review these packages against the competing quotation and return your most competitive revision.
Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Answer request for figures with verified rival offer; continue approximately EUR 4,000 steps consistent with observed 1.55 response ratio.

message.subject: PH-100 – further price movement and payment alternatives
message.body:
Guten Tag Herr Moser,

Thank you for your price movement. We respect your decision to keep margins internal and will not pursue that disclosure further.

We increase the 30-day proposal from EUR 47.30 to EUR 47.75 per unit, retaining 24 months and an effective date of 2027-04-01. We also offer higher prices for longer payment terms so you can assess the financing trade:
A: EUR 47.75 per unit, 30 days net, 24 months, effective 2027-04-01.
B: EUR 47.90 per unit, 45 days net, 24 months, effective 2027-04-01.
C: EUR 48.05 per unit, 60 days net, 24 months, effective 2027-04-01.
FCA and the 35-day lead time remain unchanged for all three.

Please review the additional price movement against your April offer and indicate which payment structure you can support, including the corresponding price for any alternative.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Einkauf, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Respond to the supplier's movement-following pattern with a EUR 0.45 price concession, about 1.5x the previous step. Compare compensated payment alternatives before a likely final offer; retain 24 months and April date.

trace.final_text: Revised counteroffer sent with the requested competing-quote data.
Sent an increased price proposal with three payment-term alternatives.

message.subject: SH-220: further commercial revision
message.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,
Thank you for the price improvement. We increase our proposal while preserving the 42-day production window and the confirmed 6,000-unit annual volume over 24 months.
A: EUR 11.75/unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 42 days, EXW.
B: EUR 12.34/unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 42 days, DAP.
C: EUR 11.83/unit, payment 45 days net, lead time 42 days, EXW.
Please review the higher price offered under B against arranging freight through your forwarder, and compare A with your standard payment period under C. We would like your revised quotation for the package that gives the strongest overall commercial result.
Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Continue meaningful EUR 4,000 move; test delivered freight and supplier-standard payment without overpaying for either.

trace.final_text: Further counteroffers sent, comparing early payment, standard payment and delivered freight.

message.subject: PH-100 – retaining your preferred payment structure
message.body:
Guten Tag Herr Moser,

Thank you for clarifying your payment preference. We retain 30 days net and withdraw the longer-payment alternatives.

In response to your reduction, we increase our 30-day proposal by EUR 0.30 to EUR 48.05 per unit, with a 24-month contract effective 2027-04-01, FCA and a 35-day lead time unchanged. This combines further price movement from us with the prompt payment and longer commitment that support your operations. Please review your April price on that basis.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Einkauf, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Supplier reduced by exactly EUR 0.30 twice, despite a larger previous buyer move; use EUR 0.30 rather than overpay for capped movement. Retain its preferred payment structure and April date.

trace.final_text: Sent a €48.05 proposal retaining the supplier’s preferred 30-day payment terms.

message.subject: SH-220: calculation basis and revised packages
message.body:
Dear Ms Aigner,
Thank you for the internal review. On your question about proof: the cost inputs available to us are your attached breakdown—material EUR 5.56, labour EUR 4.39 and conversion EUR 2.81 per unit. Our target is a commercial negotiating proposal, not a claim to know your internal margin or cost limit. We respect that these remain confidential.
We make a further price move and propose either:
A: EUR 12.06/unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW.
B: EUR 12.65/unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP.
Both cover the same 6,000 units annually over 24 months, preserve early payment and require no premium delivery. Under B we offer a higher unit price for your arranging freight. Please review the two structures and return the best workable revision.
Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Continue a EUR 3,953 concession while below direct cost, answer calculation question accurately from its attachment, and test freight structure before final offer.

trace.final_text: Revised EXW and DAP packages sent, with a clear response on the calculation basis.

message.subject: PH-100 – revised April package
message.body:
Guten Tag Herr Moser,

Thank you for your further adjustment and for recognising our payment and contract commitments. We reciprocate with another EUR 0.20 per unit of price movement.

Our revised proposal is EUR 48.25 per unit, 30 days net, a 24-month contract effective 2027-04-01. FCA and the 35-day lead time remain unchanged. Please review a corresponding adjustment to your offer while retaining this supply and payment structure.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Einkauf, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Continue while open. Supplier's last reduction was EUR 0.20; match with a measured EUR 0.20 move, preserve its preferred non-price terms, avoid signalling finality.

trace.final_text: Sent a revised €48.25 proposal with the supply and payment terms unchanged.

message.subject: SH-220: acknowledgement of final quotation
message.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,
Thank you for your final quotation and the work you have put into the alternatives. We acknowledge the stated terms and validity and are reviewing the submissions. We will respond with our award decision.
Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Keep final offer alive without further pressure while German supplier's revision is in flight.

trace.final_text: Final quotation acknowledged without requesting further concessions.
Accepted Demo Drehteile’s offer: €13.30/unit, EXW, 14-day payment and 35-day lead time; total case cost €168,959.47.

message.subject: PH-100 – additional movement on the April price
message.body:
Guten Tag Herr Moser,

Thank you for your revised offer. We make a further EUR 0.30 per unit adjustment to our proposal while maintaining the longer commitment and your preferred payment cycle.

We propose EUR 48.55 per unit, 30 days net, 24 months, effective 2027-04-01, with FCA and 35-day lead time unchanged. Please review the additional price movement and reflect it in your April quotation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Einkauf, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: A EUR 0.20 price move bought only EUR 0.10; use EUR 0.30, which previously bought EUR 0.20, rather than a token move. Supplier remains open; seek one further step without announcing readiness or finality.

trace.final_text: Sent a €48.55 proposal, retaining the agreed contract structure.
Accepted: €49.10 per unit, 30 days net, 24 months, effective 1 April 2027.
